_comment: LineageLens tier capability contract. This is the single source of truth for what each release tier includes. Docs, scripts, dashboard, and health endpoint should all reference this definition. Last updated: 2026-05-31.

base.label: LineageLens Base
base.audience: Individual developers who want local AI insertion capture with zero setup
notes: Captures filePath, insertedCode, linesAdded, confidence, and source only.
Does NOT capture the prompt sent to the AI or the model name.
No CodeLens inline blame â€” planned for a future release.
All data stays in VS Code globalState on the developer's machine.
Published to VS Code Marketplace as karnatipraveen.lineagelens-base.

lite.label: LineageLens Lite
lite.audience: Solo developers or small teams who want full local provenance without external infrastructure
notes: Single Docker container â€” backend + proxy only.
SQLite file stored in ./data/lineagelens.db â€” no Postgres required.
Search is keyword-only (no vector/semantic search).
Best demo tier: full prompt, model, file, risk, and provenance locally.
Not designed for shared multi-user access â€” use Plus for that.

plus.label: LineageLens Plus
plus.audience: Small teams using a private shared backend with governance controls
notes: PostgreSQL required (pgvector image used but vector search is off by default).
Search is keyword-only. VECTOR_SEARCH_ENABLED=false in this tier.
SSO/OIDC is NOT included â€” use Max for that.
MCP server available for Claude Code / Cursor / Continue integration.
GitHub Actions gate for blocking high-risk AI code in CI.
Includes team management, RBAC (admin/member), audit export, reviews, and webhooks.

max.label: LineageLens Max
max.audience: Regulated teams needing audit trails, policy enforcement, graph lineage, and SSO
notes: Neo4j 5+ required â€” adds ~60s cold-start on first boot.

pgvector with cosine_distance for similarity search. With default EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=hash this is hash-based (deterministic, not semantic meaning). Set EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=openai for real semantic search.
SSO/OIDC via full OIDC discovery (works with Okta, Auth0, Azure AD, etc.).
Retention and redaction policies per workspace.
Helm chart available for Kubernetes deployment.
EMBEDDING_PROVIDER defaults to hash (deterministic, no quality); set to openai for real embeddings.
Not yet SOC 2 / ISO 27001 validated â€” treat as developer-governance tooling until that work is done.
